justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Appropriate seating reduces pressure injury risk and improves function; SMS-specific comparative outcomes not available.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: SMS certification requires significant experience; multiple training pathway options available.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in seating clinics, SCI programs, and CRT specialty practices; limited in general outpatient.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: SMS supports complex rehab technology (CRT) billing; CMS requires qualified supplier documentation for power wheelchair codes; significant Medicare impact.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Consistent demand in CRT clinics and SCI centers; required by some CRT suppliers for billing eligibility.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Wheelchair users value clinicians who understand their mobility needs.
justifications.healthTech.industryPlacement: Complex rehab technology vendors (Permobil, Quantum, Ki Mobility) recruit SMS-credentialed clinicians.
justifications.healthTech.vendorDemand: Steady demand within complex rehab manufacturers and dealers.
justifications.healthTech.salaryPremium: Modest premium for vendor clinical-education roles.
justifications.healthTech.technicalSkillDepth: Builds engineering-adjacent knowledge of seating systems, power components, and electronics.
justifications.healthTech.transitionFit: Recognized pathway into complex rehab industry.
justifications.healthTech.efficiency: Moderate training burden with defined industry pay-off.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Equipment is funded by insurance/Medicaid/VA — minimal cash-pay market.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: ATP/SMS holders can command consulting fees from DME vendors but limited private-pay leverage.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Few clinicians hold SMS; strong differentiation in complex rehab niche.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Possible to build a wheelchair clinic but heavily tied to vendor partnerships and the credentialed clinician.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Low consumer-facing demand; demand comes from referring providers and vendors.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires ATP first then SMS — multi-step path of moderate cost.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Recognized specialty for neuro/peds faculty teaching assistive technology and complex rehab.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Modest but growing literature in seating, pressure injury, and wheeled mobility outcomes.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Directly enhances neuro, peds, and assistive technology coursework.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Reasonable evidence for pressure mapping and outcomes but smaller trial base.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Sometimes preferred for neuro/peds faculty lines but rarely required.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Moderate — RESNA exams and prerequisite hours are accessible.
